Drive the deal to closure with clear next steps, strong deal governance, and accurate forecasting.
Orchestration across presales & delivery
Partner with Solutions Engineers to run workshops/demos and de-risk technical concerns (security, integration, rollout).
Align with Customer Success on implementation readiness, success criteria, and expansion paths.
Ensure clean handoffs from close → kickoff, maintaining continuity of value narrative and outcomes.
Competitive positioning
Position blp against point tools and fragmented stacks (OCR/IDP/workflow/process mining/RPA) with an "end-to-end + exceptions-first" narrative.
Anticipate and neutralize competitive plays with crisp differentiation and proof.

Must-haves
5–10+ years of enterprise B2B SaaS selling experience (or equivalent complex solution sales), with a consistent track record of hitting/exceeding targets.
Proven ability to run insight-led enterprise sales cycles: you can respectfully push back, quantify impact, and mobilize buying committees.
Strong executive presence with CFO/CIO/Head of Shared Services and comfort navigating enterprise procurement.
Ability to manage complex, multi-threaded deals: mutual action plans, MEDDICC-style qualification, forecasting discipline.
Strong collaboration with presales/SE and post-sales teams; you sell what can be delivered.
Strong plus
ERP/SAP exposure (S/4, ECC, Public/Private Cloud) or selling into finance/procurement/shared services transformations.
Experience selling automation platforms (workflow/RPA/process mining/IDP) and winning against incumbents.
Experience with global enterprise rollouts and multi-country stakeholders.
Language
Fluent in English and German (or another major European language depending on territory).
You'll Get
A product that wins: strong differentiation and real enterprise proof points.
Uncapped earnings: high, realistic OTEs with uncapped commission.
Real ownership: employee-owned company; choose annually to take variable compensation in cash or shares.
Growth and autonomy: build your path in a rapidly scaling, international company.
Continuous learning: structured onboarding plus ongoing coaching.
Exceptional team: ambitious, collaborative colleagues who push each other to excellence.

Kertos is the fastest-growing compliance startup in Europe. Following our €14M Series A , backed by leading VCs and business angels, we are building the compliance engine for Europe – faster, smarter, and more automated than ever.

With customers like Enpal, Flink, Personio, and Blacklane , leading companies trust our AI-native platform that automates compliance, scales effortlessly, and makes organizations audit-ready in record time. The market is growing by 20% every year , fueled by regulations like GDPR, NIS2, DORA, and the AI Act .

We are perfectly positioned to establish Kertos as the European compliance champion. There has never been a better moment to join our team. Come shape the future of compliance in Europe with us.
Your purpose at Kertos
Als Channel Sales Manager übernimmst du die Gesamtverantwortung für den Partnerkanal von Kertos – von der Pipeline bis zum Umsatz. Du baust das Ökosystem von Grund auf auf: du entscheidest, welche Partner wir angehen, gewinnst sie und machst aus diesen Beziehungen eine verlässliche, messbare Wachstumsquelle. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Sales, Marketing und Product zusammen, damit Partnerschaften kein Silo bilden, sondern echten Impact im gesamten Unternehmen erzeugen.
Auf- und Ausbau des Partnerkanals mit belastbaren, vertrauensbasierten Beziehungen zu Key-Partnern – mit dem Ziel, Umsatzwachstum zu treiben und Partner- und Kundenzufriedenheit sicherzustellen.
Rekrutierung und Onboarding kommerzieller Partner, darunter Reseller und MSSPs, sowie kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Partner-Go-to-Market-Strategie.
Entwicklung skalierbarer Prozesse zur Gewinnung, Aktivierung und langfristigen Betreuung strategischer Partner – damit das Programm strukturiert und nachhaltig wächst.
Konzeption und Durchführung von Partner-Enablement-Programmen, Webinaren und Trainings, die Partner in die Lage versetzen, Kertos selbstständig und überzeugend bei ihren Kunden zu positionieren.
Aufbau eines nachhaltigen Partner-Ökosystems, das qualifizierte Leads bei Endkunden generiert und neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten erschließt.
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing, Product und Sales, um Partnerinitiativen mit den Unternehmenszielen abzustimmen und den Partnerkanal konsequent weiterzuentwickeln.
The skills, motivation, and mentality you should bring
Du hast nachweislich Partnerprogramme im B2B SaaS-Umfeld aufgebaut oder wesentlich mitgestaltet – idealerweise in einem Startup oder Scale-up.
Du hast einen Hintergrund im Channel Sales mit einer quota-carrying Rolle und hast langjährige Erfahrung darin, wie Pipeline über Partner generiert und Deals gewonnen werden.
Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und lieferst Ergebnisse, auch wenn kein Playbook existiert – das ist dein bevorzugtes Umfeld, nicht dein Problem.
Deine Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten auf Entscheiderebene sind auf Deutsch und Englisch gleichermaßen stark.
Erfahrung in der Compliance-, Cybersecurity- oder Legal-Tech-Branche ist ein echtes Plus – du weißt, wer unsere Kunden sind und welche Partner für sie relevant sind.
Du misst deinen Erfolg an Partnership-sourced Pipeline und ARR.

Dein Erfolg ist unser Erfolg : Du partizipierst am Unternehmenserfolg durch unseren Virtual Share Incentive Plan (VSIP)
Cutting Edge AI Technologie : Führende VCs haben in unsere Vision und nachhaltiges Wachstum investiert, damit wir nachhaltig verändern, wie Compliance-Maßnahmen gehandhabt werden

Keep growing : Um deine berufliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung zu unterstützen, stellen wir dir ein jährliches Budget von 1.500€ zur Verfügung
Volle Flexibilität : Ob im Münchner Hauptquartier, Berliner Büro oder aus dem Homeoffice – wir sind flexibel und du happy

Lucis is building its B2B distribution (department stores, wellness retail, premium clubs and studios, pharmacy networks..) and corporate licence accounts in France, the UK and beyond. Signing them is one job. Making them produce is this one.
You report to the Head of Sales & Partnerships, who stays accountable for portfolio performance and co-leads the enterprise accounts with you.
Your primary number: licences bought, then licences used. How many were purchased, and how many became a member who booked, got drawn and read their report. The first is this year's revenue. The second is whether it renews.
What you could own
Launch and activation: tracked code live, partner staff trained, launch communication shipped. Then a monthly review with every partner and account on licences bought and members activated, and a quarterly business review carrying a renewal and expansion plan.
The recurring book: corporate and enterprise licence accounts plus embedded partners, on adoption, activation rate, renewal and upsell.
Partner productivity: every partner carries a licence volume expectation and a date. You hold it, and you say out loud when a partner is not going to produce.
Member onboarding: from licence granted to first report read. The drop-off points, the reminders, the friction. With Product and Ops, who own the in-product mechanics.
Retention: no GRR or NRR baseline exists on this portfolio today. You define both, build them and report them.
Proof: documented reference cases the next deal is sold on. Honest results only, and never a health ROI claim.

You’re passionate about the future of human health and want your work to help people stay healthy for longer. You move quickly from idea to execution, take full ownership of what you build, and work best with talented people who care as much as you do.
You thrive in fast‑moving environments, learn by doing, and value feedback as a way to continuously improve. You use AI the way others use a calculator: naturally, to go faster and think bigger.
You’ll fit in well if
You have 4 to 8 years in account, partner or key account management, on a portfolio you carried and were measured on, not one you serviced.
You have moved activation, adoption or utilisation yourself, and can give the before, what you changed and the after. This is the core muscle of the job.
You run retention on numbers, and you can name the account you saved and the one you lost.
You have trained people you do not manage to sell your product, and you enjoy that part. The channel runs through a pharmacy counter, a store corner, a club front desk.
You have told a partner, or their sponsor, that they were not producing, with the data in hand.
You operate without an AE, an onboarding manager or a project manager behind you. Here there are none.
French and English both operational , spoken and written. Most partners are French, part of the portfolio is in the UK, the team is international.

Intro call (20 min): culture & role fit.
Technical interview (30 min)

Reference calls

We work together from our Paris hub. We’re passionate about what we’re building and believe the fastest way to create something exceptional is side by side. Rigor without ego: Audits, science, and code all deserve the same high bar.
Radical ownership: Feedback loops are short; everyone contributes to building the best version of Lucis.
Velocity over perfection: We ship daily and prefer a good decision today over a perfect one next week.
At Lucis, AI isn't just our product, it's our engine. 100% of our teams are equipped with the best AI agents. You have carte blanche to explore and automate everything that can be, so you can focus exclusively on high-value work.

Bringing Home the Dough
The Regional Account Manager will be responsible for developing the customer strategy and growing Flowers Foods ’ revenue, distribution, market share, and profitability with the company’s assigned accounts.

The ideal candidate will have extensive retail account management experience and the skillset to build relationships, conduct business, and enhance Flowers’ reputation with our customers and key decision makers.

The Regional Account Manager is responsible for building and implementing the retail customer strategy to attain volume growth targets, achieve sales goals, build market share, expand distribution, manage Accrual Budgets, and increase profitability through more effective assortment, expand authorizations, with effective strategy and tactics regionally.

s.h: Rising to the Challenge: Position Responsibilities
s.t:
· Promotes a customer-centered culture that strives to exceed customer needs, requirements, and expectations

· Develops and manages customer relationships within all levels of assigned retailers, buyers, and key decision makers; contribute to customer strategy ensuring local Flowers business objectives are achieved

· Partners with the BU/Brand Teams and Marketing to understand trends and consumer preferences and direct account strategy to maximize potential

· Works with the VP of Regional Accounts and the Brand Teams to Develop a Sales Plan that delivers Flowers sales and margin objectives within the Trade Promotion Management and accrual funding structure

· Partners internally with various other departments to properly plan, communicate and ensure excellent distributions by Flowers various distribution departments

· Achieves/exceeds all established key sales measures and targets

· Contributes to the development of the Annual Operating Plan (AOP)

· Ensures open and effective lines of communication and collaboration with VP of Sales, supporting Regional Operations team, BU/Brand Teams, Marketing, Supply Chain, and other functions to achieve enterprise goals

· Fosters an environment that engages and educates the regional team with responsibility and the tools to achieve goals at region and building level

· Leads, coaches, and supports the retail team.

· Builds and develops a high-performing sales leadership team at the regional level and builds regional culture to ensure high performance results

· Ensures compliance with all company policies and procedures (EEO, Sexual Harassment, Sarbanes – Oxley, Safety, etc.)

· Performs other duties which are deemed to be an integral part of the position, including but not limited to fulfillment of work schedules, adherence to attendance policies, and other applicable operating rules, policies, and procedures

· Possesses a minimum of 4 years’ experience working in Retail Account Management and CPG sales

· Past success in teamwork and guiding sales

· Equivalent management experience

· Ability to travel up to 25%, with some overnight travel

· Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, or Finance

· Master's degree preferred

We offer a competitive salary up to $105k and an excellent total rewards package. Interested job seekers who successfully complete the series of pre-screening questions and who appear to possess the basic qualifications for this position may be contacted for a telephone interview.

## Wir bewegen und begeistern Menschen. Einfach. Nachhaltig. Voraus. ##
Die **movon AG** bietet Geschäfts- und Flottenkunden innovative und nachhaltige Komplettpakete rund um moderne Mobilität. Unsere Lösungen umfassen Fahrzeugfinanzierungen, Leasing, Wartungsverträge, Versicherungen, Reifenmanagement sowie Tank- und Ladelösungen für klassische und elektrische Antriebsformen.
Als führender Anbieter von Flotten- und Mobilitätslösungen begleiten wir Unternehmen auf dem Weg in die Mobilität von morgen.Dabei betreust du einige der grössten Flottenkunden der Schweiz und gestaltest innovative Mobilitätskonzepte aktiv mit.
Zur Verstärkung unseres **Key Account Management** Teams am Standort **Cham, ZG,** suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine unternehmerisch denkende Persönlichkeit als **Key Account Manager 100%**.
## Wie wir dich begeistern ##
* **Mobilität inklusive:**-Dienstwagen mit Ladekarte, Parkmöglichkeit mit vorhandenen Wallboxen, E-Bike-Flotte und Car-Sharing-Angebote
* **Spezialkonditionen bei Fahrzeugkauf und Service:-**Für dich und deine Familie - weil wir wissen, wie wichtig Mobilität ist
* **Flexibilität leben:-**Vereinbare Familie, Hobby und Beruf - geniesse die Flexibilität des hybriden Arbeitens
* **Fit for free:-**Nutze unser kostenloses Fitnessstudio für deine Gesundheit und Fitness
* **Kulinarischer Genuss:**-Freue dich auf frische Pizza und exzellenten Kaffee von unserem hauseigenen Pizzaiolo und Barista sowie auf weitere attraktive Angebote
## Was du bei uns bewegen kannst ##
* **Ganzheitliche Kundenbetreuung:** Du bist verantwortlich für die Akquise, Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung von strategisch wichtigen Schlüsselkunden im Bereich Full-Service-Leasing und Flottenmanagement
* **Strategische Kundenentwicklung:** Du arbeitest direkt mit Entscheidungsträgern auf Management- und C-Level zusammen und entwickelst langfristige Mobilitätsstrategien für einige der grössten Schweizer Flotten
* **Partner- und Händlernetzwerk:** Du betreust, pflegst und entwickelst unsere strategischen Handelspartner und förderst die nachhaltige Zusammenarbeit innerhalb des Netzwerks
* **Aussendienst & Marktbearbeitung:** Du bist regelmässig bei Kunden und Handelspartnern in der Deutschschweiz vor Ort, erkennst neue Geschäftspotenziale und baust bestehende Beziehungen weiter aus
* **Projekt- & Umsetzungssicherheit:** Du stellst sicher, dass komplexe Flottenprojekte in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Account Management erfolgreich umgesetzt werden
* **Zukunftsmobilität gestalten:** Du erkennst Marktpotenziale im Bereich Elektromobilität und neuer Mobilitätslösungen und entwickelst daraus nachhaltige Kundenkonzepte
* **Verantwortung & Integrität:** Du stellst die Einhaltung aller relevanten Legal- und Compliance-Vorgaben sicher
* **Marke leben:** Du repräsentierst die movon AG professionell bei Kundenanlässen, Branchenveranstaltungen und Netzwerkaktivitäten
## Das bringst du mit ##
* **Ausbildung & Erfahrung:**-Eine kaufmännische oder technische Grundausbildung sowie mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb von Leasing-, Fleet- oder Mobilitätslösungen sowie nachweisbare Erfolge im Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung von strategischen Kundenbeziehungen
* **Branchenkenntnisse:** Erfahrung im projektorientierten Verkauf von Gesamtlösungen sowie in der Betreuung von Grosskunden & Stakeholdern
* **Sprachkompetenz:**-Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch in Wort und Schrift und gute Kenntnisse in Französisch, Italienischkenntnisse von Vorteil
* **Service & Kommunikation:-**Ausgeprägte Dienstleistungsorientierung, Beratungskompetenz und Freude am Umgang mit unterschiedlichsten Anspruchsgruppen
* **Verhandlung & Präsentation:**-Überzeugendes Auftreten sowie Erfahrung in der Erstellung und Präsentation von kundenindividuellen Lösungskonzepten
* **Struktur & Lösungsfokus:**-Selbstständige, strukturierte und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise mit hoher Eigenverantwortung
## Denkst du, dass wir zusammenpassen könnten? ##
Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Online-Bewerbung. Übrigens: Ein Motivationsschreiben brauchen wir nicht.
Hast du Fragen zur Stelle oder zum Bewerbungsprozess? Dann kontaktiere mich doch einfach per WhatsApp Kurznachricht. Informationen zum Datenschutz findest du in unseren Datenschutzbestimmungen.

Build something monumental for Healthcare!
At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.
We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!

We’re looking for an Senior Account Executive to grow our footprint across France. You’ll be at the forefront of introducing Tandem’s clinician copilot to providers, partners, and health systems - shaping how we scale across France
This is a pivotal role where you’ll forge high-impact partnerships across the care ecosystem, from provider networks and EHR vendors to resellers and health insurers. You’ll act as a market expert, relationship builder, and operator all in one.

Identify, initiate, and manage key relationships across the healthcare landscape in France.
Open doors with provider groups, EHR vendors, system integrators, payors, and commercial resellers to accelerate Tandem’s reach and adoption.
Pitch, negotiate, and close deals that deliver strategic value, working closely with legal, product, and commercial teams to get contracts across the line.
Represent Tandem externally in meetings, events, and conferences, positioning us as a trusted digital health partner.
Bring the voice of the market back into Tandem, sharing insights that inform product development, regulatory priorities, and local go-to-market strategy.
Help build the customer success and support infrastructure that ensures our partners thrive with Tandem.

Proven experience with healthcare partnerships, sales, or business development - ideally in health-tech, med-tech, with familiarity of the hospital ecosystem
A strong track record of closing strategic partnerships in complex, regulated environments with providers, EHRs, or pharmaceutical companies.
Deep knowledge of the French hospital ecosystem - from payors and providers to health IT vendors and regional nuances.
A strong local network and ability to build trusted relationships across stakeholder groups.
Comfortable navigating clinical, commercial, and technical conversations.
Fluent in French and English, with excellent communication skills.
Independent operator with the ability to collaborate closely with cross-functional teams.
Passion for improving healthcare delivery through thoughtful, impactful innovation.

Experience working with or selling into EHR providers, health systems, or care delivery platforms.
Background in medtech, digital health, healthcare
Familiarity with EU/French regulatory and compliance environments.
Experience in startup or high-growth environments, especially launching new markets.

We believe the best ideas happen when we’re together. This is a full-time role based in Paris, France. You’ll travel regularly - either to meet clinicians around France or to collaborate with our team in Stockholm.

s.h: Our interview process consists of 4 stages
s.t:
Screening interview with Talent Acquisition
First interview with our Country Director in France
Working Day - Join us in the Paris office for a day to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action.
Culture at Tandem
At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.
Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.
Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.
We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.
Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.

Support and develop a proposal to align new efforts with long-term strategic vision and engineering objectives, and to ensure contract requirements are executable
